svg.text: Built the aggregator, then the team, then the company. Group leadership across five countries.
PSP licence, domestic interoperability, AML/CFT framework — granted.
Product portfolio and engineering standards; designed and shipped narrevo.ai.
Full technical audit, then restructuring. Dispatch engine rebuilt; five-person in-house team created.
First electronic signature platform in Africa.
Digitalisation of financial services; web and mobile delivery.
Yatouze platform — 25 people across six countries; application security review.
Ticketing, real estate, insurance, travel, delivery marketplace; advisory to West African fintechs.
